extracted.name: Easy Kutsinta
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cup brown sugar OR 1 cup white sugar (if using flavocols)
instruction_lines: Just add all the ingredients together and mix well. Spray your molds with cooking spray and wipe it with oil. Pour mixture into each mold and place it in your steamer. Steam for about 10 to 15 minutes in medium heat. Sprinkle some coconut on top. Share and Enjoy!
